images.title: Three practice hinges and the quarter-turn guide
images.purpose: Compare the greatest turn of three practice hinges with a quarter turn: one opens exactly to the guide, one less, one more.
images.composition: Three equal panels in a row, each showing one hinge with its base arm, its opening arm and a dashed quarter-turn guide.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three panels, each 420 by 560 px with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a very pale cream #FFF8E7 fill, at x 50 to 470, x 518 to 938 and x 986 to 1406, all y 100 to 660. In every panel the hinge pivot is a dark dot 24 px across. Pivots: panel P at (150, 560), panel Q at (618, 560), panel R at (1186, 560). In every panel a teal #0072B2 base arm (10 px line, 240 px long) goes from the pivot to the right along y 560, and a dashed grey #6B7280 guide line (4 px, 240 px long) goes straight up from the pivot, with a small square corner mark (36 by 36 px, thin dark outline) at the pivot between the base arm and the guide. The amber #E69F00 opening arm (10 px line, 240 px long) goes from the pivot: in panel P exactly along the dashed guide (straight up, so it covers the guide); in panel Q up and to the right so that it is clearly narrower than the guide, ending at (618 + 240 times 0.64, 560 minus 240 times 0.77), about (772, 375), with a red #D55E00 curved arc of radius 70 px between the base arm and the opening arm; in panel R up and to the left so that it is clearly wider than the guide, ending at about (1186 minus 154, 560 minus 184), (1032, 376), with the same kind of arc. The letters P, Q and R sit above the panels at y 150 (50 px, bold, dark). Captions under the panels, centred at y 710 in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (34 px, bold): a 1/4 turn under P, less than a 1/4 turn under Q, more than a 1/4 turn under R. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any arm of a different length from the others
the opening arm of P not lying exactly on the dashed guide
images.takeaway: Compare how far an object opens with a quarter turn: less, equal or more.
images.description: Three practice hinges, P opening exactly to the quarter-turn guide, Q opening less and R opening more.
images.context: Concept image for Objects That Turn. It follows the idea of the everyday objects in your maths book (a door with a hinge, scissors, tongs) as a practice picture and shows the concept's own example of three practice hinges.
images.teaching_notes: Check each arm against the dashed guide. The slip to watch is judging by the length of the arm instead of how far it has turned.

image_decisions.why: The three hinges set against the same quarter-turn guide make less, equal and more visible side by side.
